characters.name: RobertMcCall
characters.description: The main protagonist of the films, RobertMcCallis a friendly, unassuming man who works a variety of blue-collar jobs. Unbeknownst to most, Robert moonlights as a vigilante, punishing the wicked and helping the innocent. '90s Anti-Hero: Zigzagged and deconstructed withMcCall, who goes out of his way to hide this side of himself. He faked his own death to leave the CIA and retire to a quiet life and always attempts to find peaceful solution to conflicts. Yet when he does resort to violence he's a nearly unstoppableOne-Man Armyand aBlood Knightwhokills opponents in gruesome and painful ways, and he has no problemtorturing information he needs out of people. All of the people caught up in his rampage aremonumentally hateful criminals who had it coming. In spite of this, he's still much nicer and more sincerely driven by justice than most conventional examples, opting to continue the fight when he realizes the deep corruption connected to the pimps he initially kills. He also admits that he regrets the things he did during his time with the CIA. The Ace: There's no skill thatMcCallneeds that he doesn't have, from surveillance to language fluency to first aid to softball. All-Loving Hero: Though he's more violent than most examples, Robert has compassion and empathy to nearly everyone he meets. He'd actually quite prefer it if he didn't have to kill or brutalize the various ne'er-do-wells he encounters and offers them a chance to "do the right thing" and perhaps even turn their lives around. Almighty Janitor: A Home Depot employee and later Lyft driver who just so happens to be aRetired Badass.

characters.name: Susan Plummer
characters.description: Robert's old colleague and mentor. Cool Old Lady: Just as suave, smart, and witty as Robert is. Friendly Target:Murdered by the villains in the second film to give Robert a motivation to get involved in the plot. Happily Married: Susan and her husband Brian clearly adore each other. Platonic Life-Partners: With Robert. They're incredibly close and have a very intimate friendship, but Susan isHappily Marriedand the two clearly don't have romantic feelings for each other.

characters.name: Brian Plummer
characters.description: Happily Married: He and Susan clearly adore each other.

characters.name: Nicolai / Teddy
characters.description: An enforcer ofThe Mafiyasent to hunt downMcCall. Enfant Terrible: Nicolai was an orphan adopted by a kindly man who treated him like his own son. Nicolai murdered him and his wife while they slept and robbed them. Evil Counterpart: Nikolai to Robert. Both are very,verygood at killing people, and both have a background in black ops. The difference is that Nikolai isThe Sociopath, whileMcCallis motivated by caring about the people around him. Former Regime Personnel: Nicolai is a former member of the USSR secret police turned gangster. Freudian Excuse Denial: During their meeting, Robert reveals he knows Nicolai's origin. Nicolai was brought up in foster care and moved from abusive home to abusive home, until he was finally adopted byGood Parentswho gave him the love he had never known. Nicolai repaid them bymurdering them while they slept and robbing them. Robert suggests Nicolai feared they would abandon him and decided to abandon them first so he wouldNever Be Hurt Again. Nicolai mocks him for being so sentimental.

characters.name: Alina
characters.description: A prostitute who Robert befriends. Hooker with a Heart of Gold: Alina is a kind girl who's a sex worker and abused by her pimp, a ruthless Russian mobster. Robert intervening to help her is what kickstarts the film's plot, and it's later shown he helped her get into better things (she's an aspiring singer) with a generous gift.

characters.name: Masters
characters.description: A corrupt detective working for the Mafiya. Even Evil Has Standards: Masters is a dirty cop who is in bed withThe Mafiyaand is at least connected with the Irish mob as well. Even he's horrified when he discovers how violent and ruthless Nicolai is, especially when beating the Irish mob boss to death with his bare hands. My God, What Have I Done?: Masters has a seriousHeel Realizationwhen he realizes that he has gone from good (or at least well-meaning) cop to a common thug.Masters: I was a good cop!! ...Iwasa good cop... Never My Fault: Masters initially blamesMcCallfor the Russian mob almost certainly marking him for death. Robertthrows it back in his faceby reminding him that however well-meaning he originally was, he became a dirty cop, prompting Masters'Heel Realization.

characters.name: Vladimir Pushkin
characters.description: The ruthless Russian oligarch and criminal whose operation Robert has disrupted. Greater-Scope Villain: All of the villains in the first film answer to him, but hischief enforcer Teddyhas a lot more screen time, making Teddy aDragon-in-Chief. Pushkin doesn't make a full appearance until the epilogue.

characters.name: Ralphie
characters.description: A co-worker and protege of Robert's with ambitions of becoming a security guard. Character Development: He starts of as nervous and lacking self-confidence. Under Robert's tutelage, he learns to stand up for himself.

characters.name: Slavi
characters.description: A ruthless and wicked pimp who employs Alina. Hate Sink: Slavi is a misogynisticPredatory Pimpwho beats Alina to the point she needs to be hospitalized, and proves himself to be a reprehensibleSmug Snake. When Robert offers to pay him $98,000 to let her go, Slavi refuses because Alina still has "market value" and tauntingly tells Robert that he can have her for free once she's "all used up." Obviously Evil: Slavi has skulls on his wardrobe and glass skulls adorning his desk.

characters.name: Dave York
characters.description: Robert's former partner. Disney Villain Death:After gouging his eye out and stabbing him in the throat, Robert finishes off York by throwing him off the tower to his death. Even Evil Has Loved Ones:York is theBig Bad, managing his and Robert's former teammates in assassination missions. But he, along with the other team members, are courteous enough to not start anything while York's family is nearby, whichMcCallexploits. Evil Former Friend:York andMcCallwere partners back whenMcCallworked for the CIA. It's revealed that, some time afterMcCallretired, York went crooked and began taking contracts to kill political figures. He gets himself put inMcCall'scrosshairs when he kills Susan to prevent her from finding out that he was behind theMurder-Suicidein Brussels.
